figure.title: Figure 6 (continued). Aerodynamic characteristics in pitch of the various wing-body configurations. (c) Lambda = 47 deg; t/c = 0.04. (Caption as printed on the page: '(c) Lambda = 47 deg; t = 0.04.' and 'Figure 6.- Continued.')
figure.x_axis: Lift coefficient, C_L, common to the three plots of the page and labelled only under the bottom (angle-of-attack) plot: -.2 at the left frame line, 0 at the heavy axis line, .8 at the right frame line, labels every 0.1. On the graph paper the heavy vertical lines fall every 0.05 C_L (about 71.4 px), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.025), fine lines every 0.005 (about 7.1 px). The C_L = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.y_axis: Drag coefficient, C_D, scale on the right of the middle plot: labels 0, .04, .08, .12, .16, .20. The heavy horizontal lines fall every 0.02 C_D (about 71.3 px; the labels sit on every second one), a medium line halfway between them (every 0.01), fine lines every 0.002 (about 7.1 px). The C_D = 0 line is drawn heavier than the other heavy lines.
figure.content_note: Middle plot of the page only (C_D against C_L). One faired curve with 8 hollow circles without a centre dot (radius about 13 px), all single: no doubled outline or second circle seen at any point. Circle 2 (near C_L = 0) has its left edge on the heavy C_L = 0 axis line, its top edge on the 0.02 C_D grid line, and the faired curve meets it at mid-height on both sides along a C_D grid line; circle 5 has its left edge near a heavy vertical line and circle 8 its bottom edge on a heavy horizontal line. The faired curve leaves every circle at the edge. Grid lines show 1-px steps in places (e.g. along the 0.06 C_D line at x about 1721 and 1865) and the scan is slightly rotated (horizontal lines about 4 px higher at the left frame than at the right).

calibration.x_definition: C_L: vertical heavy and medium grid lines of the graph paper, every 0.025 from the left frame line (-0.20) to the right frame line (0.80).
calibration.y_definition: C_D: horizontal heavy and medium grid lines, every 0.01 from the heavy C_D = 0 line (labelled 0) to the 0.20 line (labelled .20).
